name: worktree-test-demo
description: Run a repository's tests in an isolated per-run git worktree, keep the full test log as a run artifact, and — after a human approves — attach that log to a ticket as a file. No model calls. demo/setup.sh creates a sample repository with a failing test; demo/sink.mjs plays the tracker. Needs SAMMY_CODE_RUN_ALLOW to allow `node --test`.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Path to a local git repository with a `node --test` suite.

phases.name: run-tests
phases.description: Runs inside the run's own worktree; the full log is kept even when the tests fail.

phases.name: review-log
phases.description: Open the test-log artifact on the run page, then approve to attach it.

code.source: return 'Test log captured on branch ' + state.worktrees.repo.branch + '. Approve to attach it to DEMO-1.';
